operators.name: view_as_real_forward
semantics: Apply torch.view_as_real to input complex64 tensor, yielding a real float32 tensor of shape [..., 2] with last dimension interleaved real, imag components.
No numerical computation; just a dense view conversion that must produce a contiguous output matching reference stride [2621440, 20480, 2, 1] for given shape.

operators.name: sync_batchnorm_forward
semantics: Computes SyncBatchNorm forward in training mode=False using batch statistics: for each channel c, compute mean over all N,H,W positions of x[...,c,...], then biased variance (divide by count), normalize with eps, then apply affine transform weight[c]*normalized + bias[c].
Channel axis is 1 (after view_as_real, shape [N,C,H,W] with W=2). Normalization is applied per channel across all other dimensions.
Output has same shape/dtype/device as input x.
Converts complex64 input of shape [512,128,10240] to float32 tensor of shape [512,128,10240,2] on CUDA.
Applies SyncBatchNorm forward in eval mode=False to the 4D float32 tensor, per-channel normalization with affine parameters.
Returns the normalized float32 tensor of shape [512,128,10240,2].
